summary: MediciNova filed an Item 1.01 Form 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its office lease, effective September 23, 2026, with Newport Gateway Office LLC succeeding Irvine Company LLC as landlord counterparty. The amendment extends the lease term at 4275 Executive Square, Suite 300, La Jolla, California, from January 31, 2027 to April 30, 2030, unless terminated earlier, and provides for rent increases beginning February 1, 2027. No board recommendation, financial advisor, or special-situations mechanics are referenced. The amendment will be filed as an exhibit to the third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q. This is a routine real-estate contract amendment with no risk-arb angle.
